tax.text: Perry calls for making the tax code fairer and simpler to boost jobs and paychecks, and says the government cannot keep spending money it does not have.
tax.quote: Congress needs to keep prioritizing efforts to make the tax code fairer and simpler, in the hopes of creating quality, family-sustaining jobs and bigger paychecks for every American.

immigration.text: Perry says the first step in immigration reform must be securing the borders.
immigration.quote: The first step in the immigration reform process must be to secure our borders, period.

guns.text: Perry describes himself as a staunch defender of Second Amendment rights for all citizens.
guns.quote: The Second Amendment is a Constitutional right guaranteed to all American citizens.

abortion.text: Perry supports the Supreme Court decision returning abortion policy to the states and describes abortion as the termination of innocent lives.
abortion.quote: The U.S. Supreme Court ensured that states can now make decisions regarding abortion - the termination of innocent lives - and I support the court's decision.

health.text: Perry opposes government-run health care and supported repealing and replacing the Affordable Care Act.
health.quote: the ACA failed in its core mission to decrease health care costs, which is why I supported its repeal and replacement.

energy.text: Perry backs an all-of-the-above energy approach and opposes costly new energy regulations he says would hurt jobs.
energy.quote: I won't support efforts to impose costly new energy regulations that will stifle job creation.

tax.text: Stelson favors tax breaks for the middle class rather than the wealthy and supports raising taxes on billionaires and large corporations.
tax.quote: tax breaks for the hard-working middle class, not billionaires

wages.text: Stelson calls Pennsylvania's $7.25 minimum wage outrageous and says it must be raised to at least $15 an hour.
wages.quote: The minimum wage of $7.25 in Pennsylvania is outrageous; it's lower than that of any surrounding state, including West Virginia

trade.text: She says she would repeal existing tariffs, describing them as taxes that raise costs.
trade.quote: I will repeal these tariff taxes that are increasing costs

debt.text: Stelson pledges to protect Social Security benefits that seniors have earned.
debt.quote: You earned your Social Security, and I will always fight to protect it.

housing.text: Stelson's housing plan calls for cutting regulations to make building homes faster and easier.
housing.quote: Cut Red Tape to Make it Faster and Easier to Build Homes

schools.text: Stelson praises public schools as the foundation of communities and the country.
schools.quote: Quality public schools are the bedrock of our communities and the foundation of America.

immigration.text: Stelson calls for securing the southern border and more border agents while also supporting a pathway to citizenship for Dreamers and long-term workers.
immigration.quote: We have a broken immigration system and must secure our Southern border.

guns.text: Stelson says everyone buying a gun should pass a background check and dangerous weapons should be kept from criminals and the dangerously mentally ill.
guns.quote: Everyone who purchases a gun needs to pass a background check.

abortion.text: Stelson says she will fight to restore the abortion protections that existed under Roe v. Wade.
abortion.quote: In Congress, I will fight to ensure the protections guaranteed under Roe are once again the law of the land.

health.text: Stelson supports letting the government negotiate prescription drug prices to lower costs.
health.quote: I support lowering the price of prescription drugs by allowing the government to negotiate prices.
